# Define a helper to parse song line into title and artists
def parse_song_line(line):
    # Format: "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    parts = line.split(' by ', 1)
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return None, []
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_str = parts[1].strip()
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
    return title, artists

# Test parsing on all lines
for line in song_lines:
    title, artists = parse_song_line(line)
    print(f"Title: {title}, Artists: {artists}")
